# Bundled fonts

Shipped inside the app (`app/src/main/res/font/`) so it never needs the network.

| Font | Use | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Gotu (Ek Type) | App name and display text | github.com/google/fonts, `ofl/gotu` | SIL Open Font License 1.1, see `OFL-Gotu.txt` |
| Hind (Indian Type Foundry) | All other text | github.com/google/fonts, `ofl/hind` | SIL Open Font License 1.1, see `OFL-Hind.txt` |
